correctness.rationale: The proposed set is proved globally strict 2-sumfree by finite-prefix and modular residue checks, while every complementary gap after the seed is explicitly represented by sums of two distinct earlier terms. The exact difference block and minimal (pre)period lengths then follow. Supplemental brute-force checks agree for f=5..80.

originality.rationale: The source paper conjectures all period lengths and reports proofs through g<=2f; searches for S_{f,2f+1}, g=2f+1, equivalent block formulas, and recent follow-up work located no proof of the f>=5 line. Residual uncertainty from the recency of the source is documented in REVIEW.md.

value.rationale: The theorem proves an infinite parameter line immediately beyond the stated proved boundary and gives the complete modular structure and minimal period, rather than only finite computational confirmation.
